notices.title: Wolverine’s Liam McIntyre on Prepping for His Iconic Role and His Love for All Things Gaming
notices.contentSnippet: This week on Pause for Thought, Wolverine himself joins us to chat about the upcoming Insomniac game as well as his career. He and Naomi reflect on their time at San Diego Comic-Con, they chat about his love for gaming as well as creating board games, and of course, they dive into the process of brining Wolverine to life in gaming form.
